document:0:235:0.text:
Main Material:
<style="highlight">Enchanted Celestrite</style>: Hammer it into a thin sheet and place it in the leftmost groove of the anvil.
Other Materials:
<style="highlight">Moonlit Silver</style>: Place in the second section, following the markings on the mold.
<style="highlight">Blackstone Dust</style>: Place in the third section, following the markings on the mold.

Strike the enchanted celestrite repeatedly with a heavy hammer to ensure it combines well with the other materials. During hot forging, monitor the temperature and reheat if needed.
document:0:235:0.source_cn:
"主材：
<style="highlight">注魔后的天青矿</style>，锤打至片状，置于铁砧中央凹槽
配料：
<style="highlight">月光银</style>，按模具标注在辅料A栏位注入至满
<style="highlight">黑石粉</style>，按模具标注在辅料B栏位倒入至满
锻造时需用重锤反复击打注魔后的天青矿，使其与辅料充分结合。热锻过程中需时刻注意温度，必要时重新加热。"
